title: MurmurHash3 of short keys
summary: Hash short ASCII keys with 32-bit MurmurHash3 (x86, seed 0) to an unsigned 32-bit value.
notes: Only MurmurHash3 x86 32-bit is common to the listed packages that can run here, so the task fixes that algorithm and seed 0. Inputs are ASCII so that byte and UTF-16 code unit views agree.
